FundInformation.name: Fund Information
FundInformation.definition: Identifies the fund which is one of the parties in a treasury trade.

BuyerOrSellerIndicator.name: Buyer Or Seller Indicator
BuyerOrSellerIndicator.definition: Specifies the party which is the buyer or the seller.

SubmittingParty.name: Submitting Party
SubmittingParty.definition: Specifies the party which submits a treasury trade to a matching system or to a settlement system or to a counterparty.

TradeParty.name: Trade Party
TradeParty.definition: Specifies the party which originated a treasury trade. This party may be the same as the submitting party.
